# Olam H3 Studio — Revelation and Work Graph

## Mission

Create a production-grade, mobile-first AI video workspace at `/apps/olam-h3/` using the current official MiniMax H3 API. The application must treat generations, prompts, assets, costs, and unfinished jobs as durable reusable material rather than disposable form state.

## Observed reality

- Repository: `/Users/awtsmoos/work/awtsmoos.com/geelooy`.
- App directory: `geelooy/apps`.
- `/apps` is a generated public catalog, so registration should follow its source registry rather than hand-copying a card into the page.
- MiniMax H3 current API uses `POST /v2/video_generation` and `GET /v2/query/video_generation/{task_id}`.
- H3 accepts text, first/last-frame images, reference images, reference video, and reference audio under documented mutually-exclusive mode rules.
- H3 supports 768P and 2K output, 4–15 second integer durations, and documented aspect ratios.
- H3 reference mode supports up to 9 images, 3 videos, and 3 audio references with documented file and duration limits.
- The browser must never receive the MiniMax API key.

## Work graph

```text
Olam H3 Studio
├── App registration on /apps
├── Mobile creation workspace
│   ├── prompt composer + prompt history
│   ├── asset tray + reusable IndexedDB assets
│   ├── mode compatibility engine
│   ├── model capability configuration
│   └── live estimated price
├── Persistence
│   ├── generations
│   ├── assets + Blob reuse
│   ├── prompts
│   ├── preferences
│   ├── cached video blobs
│   └── schema migration boundary
├── Generation lifecycle
│   ├── structured internal request
│   ├── secure server adapter
│   ├── MiniMax create task
│   ├── durable local queue
│   ├── status polling after reload
│   └── result URL/cache persistence
├── Libraries
│   ├── creations search/filter
│   ├── prompt library
│   ├── asset library
│   └── build-from-this workflows
├── Usage
│   ├── cost aggregation by time
│   ├── model/resolution analytics
│   └── generated seconds/success/failure
├── Settings and backup
│   ├── connection state
│   ├── cache policy + storage estimate
│   ├── pricing info
│   └── JSON import/export
└── Verification
    ├── static syntax/import checks
    ├── proxy contract checks
    ├── IndexedDB browser checks
    ├── mobile/tablet/desktop UI
    ├── /apps regression
    └── live H3 call if credential exists
```

## Evidence gates

1. No implementation claim closes until changed files are read back.
2. No UI claim closes until the route loads in a browser-equivalent runtime without console/runtime errors.
3. No API claim closes until request translation matches official H3 documentation.
4. No live-generation claim closes unless an actual configured MiniMax key produces a real task/result.
5. `REMAINING_WORK.md` stays non-empty until implementation, tests, and handoff evidence are complete.
